messages:
deploy-bot: starting canary deploy `release/v1.14.0` -> prod, canary pods in cluster-a. canary_id=canary-20260318-31. release notes: https://redwood.dev/releases/v1.14.0 :rocket:
Maya (infra): watching slo dashboards now. canaries should stay p95 < 250ms and error_rate < 0.5% over 5m window. roll criteria in runbook linked above. :eyes:
Tara - oncall: enabled canary-alerts channel integration. will forward any criticals to #eng-oncall.
Raj Patel: seeing small p95 blip on embeddings-service in canary (p95 ~ 420ms, but qps low). snapshot: `grafana/dashboard?panel=embeddings_p95&from=-5m`
Luca Moretti: can you paste the logs? wondering if it's warmup/KV cache miss. if it's cache warmup, we should let it run another 10m.
Raj Patel: logs: 
```
[2026-03-18T15:45:22Z] embeddings-service time_to_first_token=410ms path=/v1/embeddings model=rdw-embed-1 quant=8bit
[2026-03-18T15:45:23Z] cache_miss key=kv_session_abc
```
looks like prefix cache miss spike.
Maya (infra): OK that points to cold kv cache. canary has startup traffic pattern. recommend continuing for now, but keep alert thresholds tight.
Tara - oncall: toggling stricter smoke alerts: `./ops/toggles --canary canary-20260318-31 --alerts smoke=true`
pagerbot: ALERT: embeddings-service error_rate crossed 0.5% (0.72%) in canary-20260318-31 for 90s. severity=warning.
Raj Patel: errors are 5xx from third-party tokenizer endpoint timing out. not systemic to runtime. stack trace shows upstream timeouts.
Luca Moretti: canary traffic is small. we can pin model to previous tokenizer timeout workaround if it gets worse. command: `rdctl deploy --patch 'tokenizer.timeout=500ms' --to canary-20260318-31`
Maya (infra): agree keep canary running 15m total, if p95 > 300ms or errors > 1% we rollback. update: added dashboard annotation for this deploy.
Tara - oncall: 10m elapsed, p95 back to 210ms, error_rate 0.22%. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: canary health check passed, promoting canary -> stable after 20m. rollout started: rollout_id=20260318-31-stable.
Raj Patel: monitoring post-promote. will flag immediately on any regressions.
Luca Moretti: nice. will follow up with perf notes in the release doc for cache priming.
Maya (infra): leaving canary logs/Grafana saved under /runbooks/canaries/20260318-31.
Tara - oncall: closing the watch thread, reassigning to duty rotation. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: deploy complete, status=success, duration=20m9s. :tada:
